title: Wheatstone strain-gauge bridge
goal: A reader must be able to identify the excited four-arm bridge, its two active gauges, and the differential amplifier pickup.

rubric.must: Four 350 Ω arms form a closed diamond or bridge between the two VEXC terminals.
SG1 ACTIVE and SG2 ACTIVE are visibly in opposite bridge arms, while R2 and R3 are fixed arms.
The two bridge midpoints VL and VR connect separately to the plus and minus inputs of the INA333 op-amp triangle.
A 5 V source labelled VEXC is visibly connected across the top and bottom bridge nodes.
The INA333 triangle has a clearly labelled VOUT leading to a 10 kΩ load.
The amplifier supply connections show both +5 V and −5 V rails.
